name: claudeswap
description: See your active Claude Code account in the status bar and switch between accounts (personal, company) in one click.
author: LogicalAngel (https://technello.com)

commands.title: Claude: Pin Current Account to This Workspace
Claude: Unpin Account from This Workspace

claudeAccounts.statusBar.show.description: Show the active Claude account in the status bar.

claudeAccounts.account.description: Email or account id of the Claude account this workspace should use. When set, ClaudeSwap offers to switch to it when the workspace opens. Set this in workspace settings (.vscode/settings.json), usually via the 'Pin Current Account to This Workspace' command.

claudeAccounts.accountColors.markdownDescription: Status bar text colour per account, keyed by email or alias. Values are CSS colours or theme colour ids, for example `{ "you@company.com": "#4FC1FF" }`.

scripts.check:sync: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(f.readFileSync('lib/credentials.js','utf8')!==f.readFileSync('claude-plugin/lib/credentials.js','utf8')){console.error('claude-plugin/lib/credentials.js is out of date; run npm run sync:plugin');process.exit(1)}"
